decisions.rationale: "Autosomal dominant aniridia" names one defined form of aniridia (the AN2-linked type studied in this family), not a family of multiple diseases. The full phrase is the most specific minimal span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease mentions); What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: "autosomal dominant aniridia" in the abstract refers to the single specific disease under study, defined by its AN2 locus linkage and inheritance pattern, so it is a Specific Disease rather than a Disease Class.
"aniridia" is used as a noun modifier of "locus" in "the aniridia locus AN2", so the disease name modifies another concept rather than being a standalone disease mention.
